requested_notional_usd.definition: Requested stress-position size; the executable amount is separately capacity-capped.
requested_notional_usd.label: assumption

assumed_capacity_usd.definition: Unverified maximum executable notional used only to demonstrate capacity constraints; it is not claimed as observed market depth.
assumed_capacity_usd.source: Commodity-simulation placeholder pending event order-book data
assumed_capacity_usd.label: assumption

allocated_margin_usd.definition: Capital allocated to support the modelled WTI position. This is not a reconstruction of a full cross-margin account.
allocated_margin_usd.label: assumption

round_trip_fee_rate.definition: Combined entry and exit fees; an account-level fee history was not supplied.
round_trip_fee_rate.label: assumption

round_trip_slippage_rate.definition: Combined entry and exit average slippage at the assumed capacity reference point; smaller executions scale by the separate power-law exponent.
round_trip_slippage_rate.source: Commodity-simulation placeholder pending event order-book data
round_trip_slippage_rate.label: assumption

slippage_exponent.definition: Shape assumption mapping capacity utilization to average round-trip slippage; one is linear in utilization and total slippage cost is then quadratic in notional.
slippage_exponent.source: Commodity-simulation sensitivity convention pending event order-book depth
slippage_exponent.label: assumption

signed_funding_rate_over_horizon.unit: signed rate of executable notional over 49 hours
signed_funding_rate_over_horizon.definition: Positive values are attacker payments and negative values are attacker receipts.
signed_funding_rate_over_horizon.source: Commodity-simulation placeholder pending venue funding history
signed_funding_rate_over_horizon.label: assumption

capital_annual_rate.definition: Opportunity cost applied to allocated margin over the fixed holding-horizon assumption.
capital_annual_rate.label: assumption

requested_borrow_usd.definition: Requested borrow amount, capped by the historical listing-package debt ceiling.
requested_borrow_usd.label: assumption

acquisition_fee_rate.definition: One-way acquisition fee excluding size-dependent market impact.
acquisition_fee_rate.label: assumption

borrow_interest_rate_over_horizon.unit: rate of borrowed amount over 49 hours
borrow_interest_rate_over_horizon.definition: Interest accrued before the modelled strategic default.
borrow_interest_rate_over_horizon.source: Commodity-simulation placeholder pending reserve-level rate history
borrow_interest_rate_over_horizon.label: assumption

gas_and_operations_usd.definition: Fixed execution overhead for acquisition, deposit, and borrow.
gas_and_operations_usd.label: assumption

impact_exponent.definition: Shape assumption mapping trade size to average execution price impact around the observed reference quantity.
impact_exponent.source: Commodity-simulation sensitivity convention; the full order-book curve was not supplied
impact_exponent.label: assumption
